subject: Quick thought on the Sola Smiles site + a quick prototype
body: Hi Sola Smiles team, I love the whole-body, wellness-focused approach you bring to dentistry in South Austin, especially your IAOMT-certified SMART procedures and same-day CEREC crowns. While browsing your current site, I noticed two minor friction points: the booking journey takes a few too many clicks from the homepage, and the layout doesn't fully capture that boutique, spa-like feel of your practice. I put together a quick, modern prototype to show how your brand can look and convert with a cleaner layout, prominent patient reviews right above the fold, and a streamlined mobile booking flow. Feel free to check out the live preview here: https://nayom-biz-0x8644b519f68fab49-0xfd4e89823cd591a-mj8tgpeav.vercel.app. If you'd like to use this design or have me tweak anything, I'd be happy to send over the project files or chat for 5 minutes. No worries at all if you're happy with your current setup!
key_improvements: Added prominent mobile booking and call-now banner
Highlighted patient reviews and ratings above the fold
Streamlined navigation and removed deep page nesting
